privacyRule: Use only enums, booleans, UTC timestamps, counts, durations, unique safe evidence IDs, and SHA-256 values. Detailed observations remain in the exact target-local raw-artifacts/manual-evidence/<evidenceId>.proof file; identities, paths, event content, credentials, and private URLs never return.

gates.requiredEvidence: Fresh snapshot has no stable or nightly install or prior CMTrace Open/WebView2 profile; both portable launches inherit CMTRACEOPEN_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECKS=1, and installed or shell-launched activation uses an independently read-back HKCU DisableUpdateChecks=1 policy.
raw-artifacts/full/cmtrace-open.exe bytes and SHA-256 match the full-portable artifact record before launch; native WebView2 renders and remains responsive with updates disabled.
raw-artifacts/lite/cmtrace-open.exe bytes and SHA-256 match the lite-portable artifact record before launch; native UI works with updates disabled and Event Log remains intentionally absent.
Local enumeration includes Application and System; bounded independent readback confirms channel existence.
Controlled local query returns a nonzero count with source provenance; independent count is retained privately.
Narrow time query count is strictly less than the recorded wider count; equality is not a pass.
Requested level returns a nonzero count and every independently checked result has that level.
Impossible filter returns zero and does not silently widen.
Real records populate timestamp, channel, provider, event ID, record ID, and bounded provenance.
A target-local fixture exists and all seven real-EVTX tests execute; the no-fixture skip path is not accepted.
Clean copied EVTX yields records in CLI and GUI with no false damage coverage.
Tail-truncated copy reports visible incomplete coverage without crash or false completeness.
Internal missing-chunk copy reports a gap and returns independently confirmed later record IDs.
Malformed file-header copy produces a bounded visible error without crash or false clean result.
Malformed chunk-header copy produces bounded damage coverage without crash or false clean result.
Malformed record-size copy produces bounded record coverage without crash or unbounded allocation.
Malformed BinXML-token copy produces bounded XML coverage without crash or fabricated content.
Exact helper calls the native capture seam from an archived exact-head copy; all-or-nothing database remains private.
Six exact ignored tests use one isolated retained database containing more than 100 providers.
Exact-source and installed provider-db inventories, bytes, and hashes match; the manifest and both curated resources load in installed Full; missing descriptions stay explicit and are never invented.
Purpose-created safe events arrive once, in order, with sequence behavior and visible subscription mode.
Stop and cancel release subscription resources; independently created later events are not appended.
PASS only when an approved source naturally yields capability error 1, 50, 120, or 127 and polling visibly delivers records.
Files, folders, recursion, wildcards, rotations, overlaps, and duplicates preserve deterministic ordering, provenance, and deduplication.

Exact fixture folder with no valid EVTX and five sorted reparse-point children retains bounded child path and exact reason `symbolic link or reparse point is not followed during wildcard expansion` in the visible load error without traversal.
Five sorted rejected children display only the first three bounded path and reason pairs plus 2 more; fourth and fifth paths remain hidden.
Authorized real MDMDiagReport archive has nonzero members, at least one parsed EVTX member, and nonzero records; text, registry, and binary inventory remain visible as applicable.
Every ZIP directory entry agrees with native member count, normalized provenance, kind, outcome, present hash, and bounded omission accounting.
Parsed archive records retain archive member provenance and truthful chronology; CLI and GUI source, record, and coverage counts agree.
Structural-only ZIPs prove unsafe relative path, case-insensitive duplicate, and 513-member rejection boundaries without generated log evidence.
Canceling Archive-source elevation leaves the original process usable and returns a truthful cancellation.
Approved Archive-source elevation loads the private source and leaves the original process usable afterward.
An already approved snapshot loads or returns precise denied or unavailable coverage; snapshot mutation requires separate approval.
Second authorized Windows source succeeds using current OS credentials; no endpoint or credential is returned.
Denied, empty, and unavailable remote outcomes remain distinct and bounded.
Measured repeated remote open, query, and close returns handles to a stable bound; the three-loop ignored test alone is insufficient.
Canceling typed confirmation leaves the owned disposable canary channel unchanged by independent readback.
Non-elevated clear is visibly denied and leaves the owned disposable canary channel unchanged.
UAC cancellation reports cancellation and leaves the owned canary unchanged.
After snapshot and approval, only the owned canary is cleared; independent readback proves success and tail resumes afterward.
CSV, TSV, JSON, XML, HTML, raw XML, redaction, formula defense, parseability, atomic replacement, errors, empty, and large streaming agree across CLI and GUI.
Existing authorized target-local lab text and Event Log sources preserve chronological ordering and distinct provenance; no plausible log lines are generated.
Markers persist across reorder, filter, refetch, and restart while equal numeric record IDs remain isolated by source.
Before-load criteria, on-load search and quick filter, and after-load grouping compose without widening, dropping criteria, or accepting invalid input.
Exercise all six quick-filter modes, scopes, show and hide, case, highlighting, ranges, and invalid Event-ID input with private before and after counts.
Nested grouping preserves counts and records; keyboard, focus, Narrator roles and counts, collapse, expansion, and hidden-selection clearing pass.
Named before-load, on-load, quick-filter, and grouping state persists across restart and case-insensitive re-save updates rather than duplicates.
Known exact-head gap: native UI has no saved-filter import, export, favorites, tags, or recents management surface; this gate cannot be marked PASS.
Known exact-head gap: native UI has no drag-to-group or pivot interaction; ordered dropdown grouping is not equivalent and this gate cannot be marked PASS.
Quick-filter match text, marked terms, Narrator output, highlight toggle, and selected, marker, severity, match, default precedence are visible and not color-only.
Known exact-head gap: saved filter rules do not drive independently configurable per-row colors; quick-filter term highlighting is not equivalent and this gate cannot be marked PASS.
Column visibility, keyboard reorder, widths, reset, UTC and local grouping, and minimum and maximum text sizes remain aligned, readable, reachable, and persistent.
After snapshot and approval, the exact unsigned NSIS hash installs successfully.
Installed executable is PE 0xAA64 and its bytes and SHA-256 match provenance-derived NSIS installed-executable evidence.
Default Apps activation and four supported extensions open the installed app; before and after state is independently restored.
Ordinary uninstall of the one emitted Full NSIS package removes its owned files and Full stable identity without claiming removal of the separately portable Lite edition or unrelated user choices.
Approved same-account elevation completes only the owned action and returns bounded status.
Approved over-the-shoulder elevation preserves initiating context and bounded outcome without returning identity data.
Keyboard, focus, Narrator roles and counts, high contrast, 100 and 200 percent scaling, minimum size, resize, touch, reduced motion, and no color-only state pass natively.
Bounded machine evidence records build, native architecture, logical processors, CPU class, and memory without identity fields.
Three quiescent exact-head Full launches record input-idle or visible responsive window times, process-tree peak working sets, and median; this is not first-row proof.
Three cold runs on one frozen source record manually observed first visible row times and median; target-local visual evidence never returns.
Three native release-harness runs with seven days and no cap record channels, failures, gaps, events, timing, peak memory, and medians without omitted coverage.
Authorized corpus with at least 100000 real records records hash, count, first row, settled time, peak memory, responsive navigation, filtering, and grouping; no synthetic records.

Exactly three runs on authorized nonzero Intune records have positive composite elapsed time, peak memory, and resolved counts plus nonnegative missing counts. The four returned values are exact medians; all per-run values and private output hashes remain in one target-local proof, and no isolated timer is claimed.
Available named competitors and CMTrace Open use the same frozen corpus, hardware, and scenario with versions and emulation or uncontrolled limits recorded; no unsupported comparison claim.
An older authorized ARM64 install upgrades to the exact-head ARM64 package with owned state preserved; reinstalling 1.5.1 is not proof.
Local unsigned output never proves Azure signing or protected mpdev MSI; no release workflow is dispatched by this handoff.
